result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code path as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. The `cli` module compiles and its tests pass. I didn't run either command end to end, so I haven't confirmed that `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` produces `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html`.

- **`Commands.java`**: added the `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` name and a description that calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and says it is the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument usage overview lists `analyzeLandscape` before `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names go to one `updateLandscape` method, which now takes the command name and description. `analyzeLandscape -help` and `updateLandscape -help` each print their own usage.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Command line" section. It lists `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape` (noting `updateLandscape` is the older name and still works) and `updateConfig`.

`CLAUDE.md` still lists only `updateLandscape` in its command list, and I left it alone.
